limits: Blender source render evidence only. No Unreal, Nanite, HLOD, streaming or native acceptance verified.
Close fixed-distance frames may crop; fitted hero previews show complete assets.
Magnified crops are labeled. Original 1920x1080 frames are retained.
Single small clumps have limited pixel coverage at distance. Scatter evidence is essential.
Review bands are diagnostics, not automatic visual acceptance.
